attempts.text:
**The window starts on a persistent spine.** Columns 0 to 10, `ybjM` to `gstB`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, and 0 to 26% of calls there are in a region of plasticity. The model names 70 to 99% of these genes, fewest at column 2 (`rcdA`), 70%, where it is also most hesitant, 1.05 bits.

**Column 11 is variable**, `yliI`, in 88% of chromosomes, 26% of calls in a region of plasticity, named 79%, 1.29 bits, the most hesitant column of the window. Then a short spine, columns 12 to 13, `bssR` and `rimO`, 92% of chromosomes, named 84 to 90%.

**The first fork follows**, columns 14 to 15, named 78 to 82%. Its branches carry families of [[phage tail and toxin-antitoxin genes]], while the most carried line is `dgcI` and `pdeI`. A long spine runs from `gsiD` to `ybiV`, columns 16 to 26, 91 to 92% of chromosomes, named 92 to 99%, with the `gsi` genes and `moeA` to `moeB` for [[glutathione transport and molybdopterin biosynthesis]].

**Columns 28 to 29 are the most plastic spine**, `ybiT` and `ldtB`, 25 to 29% of calls in a region of plasticity, named 94 to 95%. Then 50 fork and variable columns, 30 to 79, where the model names 78 to 96% and hesitates most at column 33 (`opgE`), 1.03 bits. Two branches run there: 3 families through columns 30 to 32 and 10 through columns 36 to 45, all shell, 15 to 26%, [[phage capsid, terminase and replication genes]].

**The window ends variable.** Columns 54 to 78 carry 24 persistent families and 1 shell family, 26 to 70% of chromosomes, from `cecR` to `ybhC`, including the `moa` and `bio` genes for [[molybdopterin and biotin biosynthesis]]. Column 79, `ybhJ`, is a fork in 21% of chromosomes. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 1.46 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 73% against 96%.

label: ybjM
facts:
WINDOW: the ybjM window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ybjM, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,865 to 2,944 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ybjM once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.42 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,453 calls, named 97%, 0.16 bits; shell 8,478 calls, named 80%, 0.98 bits; cloud 1,109 calls, named 17%, 3.97 bits. Outside an RGP 35,651 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 7,389 calls, named 73%, 1.46 bits. Columns: 26 spine, 19 fork, 35 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.46 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (73% against 96%); 7,389 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 11 (yliI) 1.29 bits, RGP 26%; column 2 (rcdA) 1.05 bits, RGP 26%; column 33 (opgE) 1.03 bits, RGP 23%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 28-29 (spine), RGP 25-29%; the least: columns 30-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 4-40%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-10 (11 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-26%. Genes: ybjM "inner membrane protein YbjM", ybjL "aspartate:alanine antiporter", rcdA, ybjJ "MFS transporter", ybjI "HAD hydrolase family protein", ybjH, mdfA, ybjG "undecaprenyl-diphosphate phosphatase", deoR, dacC, gstB. named 70-99% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 2 (rcdA), named 70%, 1.05 bits.
2. column 11 variable: RGP 26%. named 79%; 1.29 bits.
   11: yliI P 88% "aldose sugar dehydrogenase YliI"
3. columns 12-13 (2 columns) spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 26%. Genes: bssR, rimO. named 84-90% (mean 87%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 12 (bssR), named 84%, 0.60 bits.
4. columns 14-15 (2 columns) fork: RGP 26%. named 78-82% (mean 80%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 14, named 78%, 0.87 bits.
   14: dgcI P 86%; also "type II toxin-antitoxin system RelE/Par…" S 23%, "phage tail protein" S 15%
   15: pdeI S 76%; also "helix-turn-helix domain-containing prot…" S 23%, "phage tail protein I" S 21%
5. columns 16-26 (11 columns) spine: share 91-92%, all P, RGP 22-26%. Genes: gsiD "glutathione ABC transporter permeas…", gsiC, gsiB, gsiA, iaaA, moeA "molybdopterin molybdotransferase Mo…", moeB, fsa, ybiY "glycyl-radical enzyme activating pr…", ybiW "formate C-acetyltransferase/glycero…", ybiV "HAD hydrolase family protein". named 92-99% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 16 (gsiD), named 92%; most hesitant at column 19 (gsiA), 0.57 bits.
6. column 27 fork: RGP 24%. named 96%; 0.27 bits.
   27: ybiU S 78% "YbiU family protein"; also "head completion/stabilization protein" S 20%
7. columns 28-29 (2 columns) spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 25-29%. Genes: ybiT "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", ldtB. named 94-95% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 29 (ldtB), named 94%; most hesitant at column 28 (ybiT), 0.40 bits.
8. columns 30-79 (50 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 4-40%. named 78-96% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 57, named 78%; most hesitant at column 33, 1.03 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 30-32, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 22-23%, all S; the branch's families: "GPO family capsid scaffolding protein", "phage terminase large subunit family pr…", "phage portal protein"
   a second branch of 10 families through columns 36-45, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 15-26%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "replication endonuclease", "DNA adenine methylase", "TraR/DksA family transcriptional regula…", "DUF2732 family protein", "DUF5347 family protein", "phage filamentation protein Fil family…", "phage regulatory CII family protein", "regulator", "phage repressor protein CI"
